title: Swing Pressure Cutoff Solenoid Hot Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a hot short circuit in the swing cut-off solenoid circuit.
controller_action: Stops to drive the swing cut-off (2-stage relief) solenoid.
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the swing pressure cut off (2-stage relief) solenoid can be monitored. (As long as the command from the controller is ON, the indication on the monitor is ON even if the solenoid is not energized because there is an open circuit.) (Code: 02301) Reference information When the solenoid is ON, the swing motor relief pressure becomes "Hi".
